name: Receiving The Holy Ghost
overview: The Scriptures reveal that receiving the Holy Ghost is a divine gift promised to all who earnestly seek God, as Jesus assures that those who ask will be given the Holy Spirit (Luke 11:9,13). This outpouring fulfills God’s promise to pour out His Spirit upon all flesh, enabling believers to prophesy, dream, and see visions (Joel 2:28). Jesus emphasizes the necessity of being born of water and the Spirit to enter God's kingdom (John 3:5), and He invites all who thirst to come to Him and receive spiritual life (John 7:37). John the Baptist points to Christ as the one who baptizes with the Holy Ghost and fire, highlighting the transformative power of this baptism (Luke 3:16).
